scope: Coarse visual source/recast audit; not a row-by-row answer correctness certification
split_policy: Reserve the separate 559-row benchmark, then test, validation and train, by category + generator ID across difficulty. Native rows are removed, never reassigned.
image_policy: Original merged images, including native lettered answer panels; textual Panel A ... references survive Jev criterion permutation.

source_review.finding: Readable cube net and all four panel labels. B uses the original adjacent faces; A duplicates the airport face and C/D introduce absent faces.
Readable block geometry and all four labels. C preserves the two tall columns and base structure; sampled distractors differ.
Three source views and all four choices are readable. D is consistent with the hidden face after rotating the depicted cube.
Both source views and four component sets are readable; native C is plausible. No independent 3D solver was run.
Readable target and four lowercase panel letters. B supplies the tall column and horizontal bars; letter case does not change panel identity.

excluded_review.finding: Question refers to an arrow that is absent; B/C/D labels are missing. Entire projection category omitted rather than guessing a viewing direction or repairing pixels.

license.additional_terms: Paper notes Icons8 textures and third-party aptitude-test material; source rights remain applicable.

automated_checks.image_integrity: Every retained encoded image passes Pillow verification and matches its SHA-256 image_group_id.
automated_checks.gold: Every retained gold index matches the native CSV answer.
automated_checks.split_groups: All retained generator family IDs are disjoint across source splits and the separate benchmark.
